exposure: Fecundability (categorized by time to pregnancy - TTP)
cohort: Pregnant women who came for antenatal checkups before 20 weeks' gestation at a Maternal and Child Health Hospital in Nanjing, China.
finding: A significant decrease in the exclusive breastfeeding rate was observed in women with prolonged time to pregnancy (lower fecundability) compared to those with short time to pregnancy (higher fecundability).
